events.title: His Touch Worship Experience 2026
events.summary: Join Divine River Church for a special afternoon of praise, deep worship, prayer and fellowship.
description: His Touch Worship Experience 2026 is a special worship gathering at Divine River Church dedicated to praise, deep worship, prayer and reflection. The event brings together the church community and guests for a focused time of worship and Christian fellowship.
Members of Divine River Church, families, friends and worshippers from the wider community are welcome to attend. Entrance is free.
events.venue: Divine River Church, Nabweru, after Nabweru Police Station
